configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: The only supported configuration. Ninja single-config, so there is no --config flag and the exe lands at build/ShaderPlayer.exe.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug links the debug CRT (ucrtbased.dll, msvcp140d.dll), which windeployqt does not deploy and which only exists on machines with the Windows SDK installed. The resulting build/ directory is not distributable. Use it to step through code, not to hand to anyone.
